transcript.text: Hindi po ako smoker. Magkano po ang premium for one million coverage?

transcript.text: Whole-life participating plan. Premiums payable to age 60 or 20 years, whichever later. Builds cash value after year 3. transcript.text: Sige po, pakicall back tomorrow evening.
